instruction:
Load /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-04_input.step. To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). Before starting the work, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-04_input.step`.

Convert the 160 x 108 x 38 mm solid block into an open-top enclosure while keeping the outside envelope unchanged. Cut an internal cavity spanning X=18..142, Y=16..92, and Z=9..38, leaving a 9 mm bottom floor and continuous side walls except where openings are specified. Cut a front connector opening through the Y=0 wall spanning X=65..95 and Z=14..28. Cut a right-side connector opening through the X=160 wall spanning Y=45..75 and Z=14..26. Cut a shallow left-side service recess into the X=0 face spanning X=0..4, Y=34..56, and Z=16..26. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-04_output.step.
